title: Human Resources Intern
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
# **About PATI Group**

PATI Group is not just growing - we’re redefining what growth means in the e-commerce industry. Specializing in dietary supplements, we achieved **500% sales growth in just one year** in the U.S. market. 

Our mission? To become **Vietnam’s leading dietary supplement company by 2026**, inspiring customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

# **Job Summary**

The **HR Intern** position is a hands-on role designed to support our People department in multiple areas, especially **Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, and HR Administration**. As an HR Intern, you will help ensure the recruitment process runs smoothly, contribute to promoting our company culture and brand to potential candidates, and assist with day-to-day HR operations. This role provides a valuable opportunity to gain real-world HR experience and make an impactful contribution to our team and company culture.

# **General Information**

- **Department:** People (HR) team

- **Internship Duration:** 6 months

- **Working Hours:**

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 12:00 PM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

- **Working Location:** On-site, 18A Street No. 38, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.

# **Essential Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition (60%):** 

This is your core. You will assist People team with the recruitment process, such as:

- Post job openings on various platforms and screening CVs to identify qualified candidates.

- Conduct preliminary phone screenings with shortlisted candidates to assess suitability and alignment with job requirements.

- Manage and schedule interview arrangements, ensuring a smooth interview process for both candidates and Hiring Managers.

- Record, organize, and manage recruitment data to ensure accuracy and accessibility.

**2. Employer Branding (30%):**

To promote the company’s culture and employer brand, you will have chance to:

- Create and share engaging content on social media (Facebook, LinkedIn,...) and career sites.

- Assist in executing employer branding campaigns, and engage with potential candidates online.

**3. Administrative Support (10%):**

- Assisting in the onboarding process for new hires to ensure a smooth welcome experience.

- Coordinating office activities and events as needed.

- Perform other tasks as assigned by the Manager.

# **Who We Are Looking For?**

- Senior or graduated students who can commit **a full-time internship.**

- **Strong interest in the Human Resources field**, specifically in Talent Acquisition, with a keen focus on high-technology trends.

- **Good command of English** (Written and Spoken), equivalent to an IELTS score of 6.0.

- **Strong organizational and communication skills** to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external candidates.

- A positive, “can do” attitude with **proactive learning behavior**.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with HR tools (or willingness to learn).

- Alignment with our core values: **Honor Our Word, Play Like A Team Sport, Foster Innovation** (Check out more at [patigroup.com](https://patigroup.com/)). If you embody these values, show us proof!

# **Benefits and Learning Opportunities**

- **Allowance: **Up to 4,000,000 VND per month.

- Opportunity to work in a **fast-growing E-commerce business**, with a professional, dynamic, and friendly working environment.

- Opportunity to get **hands-on experience** in full-cycle Recruitment and Employer Branding projects, allowing you to develop practical skills in Talent Acquisition with **in-depth training** from outstanding leaders.

- **Exposure to modern HR tools**, including Lark System, AI, and Automation, to streamline HR processes and workflows.

- Participate in various **team bonding activities**.

- Have the **opportunity to become a full-time employee **after the internship.

# 🚀 APPLY **[HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**

(Make sure you have read and agreed to our working location and hours, including joining our Saturday activities.)
